# ”Inte så kul att vara centralbankschef i dessa tider”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-18  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon's Friday pre-open show covered central bank moves. Bank of Japan raised its rate to 1.25%, the highest since 1995, on a split 7-2 vote. The hosts also discussed Fed and Bank of England decisions, SEB's revised Fed forecast and whether the Riksbank will raise rates next week. Markets were described as resilient: global stocks rose, led by tech after Nvidia comments on AI chip sales, and Swedish banks and AcadeMedia outperformed after the Swedish election. Stockholm was expected to open slightly lower ahead of quadruple witching. Stock-specific items included Nordea's upgrade of Gränges to buy, insider buying in Synka (formerly Vestum), and the risk that US prediction markets pose to Kambi.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 GRNG — Gränges | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Nordea upgraded from hold to buy with SEK 210 target; major owner Jofam bought more shares.

#### Reasoning

This is cited analyst opinion (Nordea), not the hosts' own view. The upgrade from hold to buy, target SEK 210, is backed by a major owner (Jofam) adding shares, which signals insider/owner conviction. The hosts flag the stock as likely to move today but give no view of their own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nordea or other analysts downgrade
- if Jofam stops buying or sells shares
- if the price reaches the SEK 210 target

> *"Gränges som har fått en höjd rekommendation från Nordea. Gå från behåll till köp, rikskurs 210 kronor. Storägare Jofam har köpt mer aktier i bolaget."*

---

### 🟠 KAMBI — Kambi | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

The CFTC opening up US prediction markets could hurt Kambi, since they compete with sports betting.

#### Reasoning

This is the hosts' speculative view. Regulatory clearance for prediction markets and crypto trading in the US creates a competitor to traditional sportsbook providers like Kambi. They expect a possible negative reaction today, but conviction is low.

#### Sell Triggers

- if prediction markets take significant sports-betting share
- if US regulation expands further in favour of prediction markets

> *"Det här skulle kunna påverka Kambi kanske lite negativt idag eftersom man ser att de här Prediction Markets egentligen är konkurrenter till Sportsbetting."*
